animation_inventory_gate.note: The authored infinite keyframe tracks are the exact gate. CSSTransition liveness is a capture-timing fact, is recorded under transient_animation_diffs, and is not a parity defect.

D3: step-done signature derived from that same random percentage

screenshot_stabilization.timing: AFTER all hard channels are collected, screenshot channel only
screenshot_stabilization.desktop_tablet: authored AUTO 360 control stops the JS auto rotation
screenshot_stabilization.mobile: D4 proven first (#autoBtn display:none, user_reachable=false, auto_loop_active=true); the harness may then DOM-click the same authored handler for paired stabilization and records HARNESS_ONLY_NOT_USER_REACHABLE
screenshot_stabilization.animations: after the inventory is recorded, existing CSS/Web Animation objects may be paused and phase-locked identically on both surfaces, browser-side test code only
screenshot_stabilization.runtime_source: no stabilization is written into any runtime source file

requires: accepted below-fold control bounding boxes and y positions

visual_comparison.note: Screenshots are an EVIDENCE channel. If phase-locked captures happen to be byte-identical that is recorded, never required.

forbidden: any change to the four protected runtime blobs
any change to the 160 vendored PNGs
framework, Product, backend, Auth or DB change

capture_order: M1: D4 native proof BEFORE stabilization
intent-driven AUTO handling (real click desktop/tablet, same authored control DOM click on mobile -> HARNESS_ONLY_NOT_USER_REACHABLE)
finite authored CSS transition settle (STABLE only)
settle_policy.unclassified_residual: REAL PARITY DEFECT - never a ledger row
settle_policy.contact_sheet: temporary review artifact outside the capsule; never committed; review-pack stays exactly 12 PNGs

semantic_reporting.SEMANTIC_RAW_EXACT: measured raw equality, no projection and no exclusion
semantic_reporting.SEMANTIC_CONTRACT_EXACT: exact after ONLY the authorized D2/D3 projection and ledger-backed classes; must be 36/36 for a candidate PASS
semantic_reporting.forbidden: describing a partial raw count as exact across all 36

required_order: wait INITIAL AUTHORED READINESS (heroWrap not .out, hero decoded, no running startup CSSTransition)
M1 only: prove D4 while the authored AUTO loop is still ACTIVE
if STABLE: pause AUTO BEFORE the state driver (real user click desktop/tablet; same authored DOM control on mobile -> HARNESS_ONLY_NOT_USER_REACHABLE) and verify PLAY
wait that state's observable TERMINAL PREDICATE (semantic, not a bare sleep)
phase-lock ONLY the infinite authored CSSAnimation tracks (drift/scan/spin with infinite iterations)

angle_determinism.finding: the authored build() ends with autoLoop(850), so the first authored angle tick lands around 800-860 ms and varies between runs; the startup readiness gate cannot complete before roughly 1100 ms, so an AUTO pause alone always lands AFTER that first tick
angle_determinism.resolution: the harness drives the AUTHORED updateAngle() back to 000 (the same function the authored drag/keyboard/wheel/auto handlers call) so both surfaces are compared at an equal authored angle; an angle-pinned state is rewound BEFORE its drag so the authored drag outcome is deterministic

hard_channel_residual_ledger.rule: every non-exact geometry/computed-style field on an AUTHORED_LIVE or EXPLICIT_TRANSIENT state is written to evidence/s4/residual-ledger.json with exact state, field path, per-side values, per-side liveness, stabilization action, and one already-authorized classification

classification_evidence_rule.bug: the classifier previously derived the infinite class from geometryMotion === true, which only proves an element moved between samples, not that the motion came from an infinite authored CSSAnimation; the authored .toast has transition .3s and no animation, so its residuals were mislabeled
classification_evidence_rule.fix: INFINITE_CSS_PHASE_AFTER_NATIVE_PROOF requires the native animation inventory to show the affected target under a CSSAnimation with animationName in {drift,scan,spin} and iterations Infinity, on BOTH surfaces
classification_evidence_rule.finite_case: a native CSSTransition on the affected target classifies as AUTHORED_FINITE_TRANSIENT_PHASE; this is the authored .toast case
classification_evidence_rule.both_surfaces_must_agree: if the two surfaces disagree about which animation covers the target, the residual is unexplained and falls through rather than being guessed
classification_evidence_rule.recorded_per_row: native_animation_proof on every hard-channel ledger row
